text:
Maria Gonzalez: heads up — QuantumBridge (open-model provider) sent their onboarding packet. primary asks: redistribution addendum for quantized weights, marketplace sku mapping, and a bundled HW offer with SiNova. they want a single commercial redistrib clause we can use across cloud marketplaces.
Jamal Owens: can you drop their packet link? need to see exact clause.
Maria Gonzalez: https://files.internal/quantumbridge/onboarding/packet_v2.pdf — key excerpt below they pasted: 

```
Redistribution Addendum: Provider grants non-exclusive rights to distribute quantized model artifacts to customers through authorized marketplaces and resellers, limited to compiled/runtime-only artifacts. Redistribution must preserve attribution and may be geoblocked per provider region list.
```

Maria Gonzalez: they emphasized compiled/runtime-only to avoid source weight redistribution.
Sophie Patel: legal quick take — compiled/runtime-only is OK but we need explicit language about rehosting vs marketplace hosting. also clarify SIs packaging the model with hardware (SiNova) — is that allowed or requires separate reseller agreement?
Alex Cheng: product note — if SI bundles with hw, SKU mapping needs to reflect: (1) hosted via Redwood (marketplace SKU) (2) download license (if allowed) (3) on-prem private deployment SKU. QuantumBridge prefers option 1+3 only.
Ryan Park: partner-eng perspective — SiNova is asking for co-marketing and a joint SKU that ties a HW serial to a marketplace entitlement. this raises billing/inventory work. can we gate that behind a partner connector instead of special SKU?
Sophie Patel: legal — connector approach is cleaner. avoids creating a new SKU for every HW model. but we must add a clause: "Partner may bundle runtime artifact only; resale of weights or derivative models prohibited." also need indemnity language for export controls if provider is in EEA.
Jamal Owens: ops — if we allow geoblocking, what's the implementation surface? per-account geo allowlist or per-entitlement?
Alex Cheng: we prefer per-entitlement so marketplace listings can have region restrictions at purchase time. fewer runtime checks.
Maria Gonzalez: QuantumBridge asked for a 30-day embargo window for the joint announcement with SiNova. they want marketing playbook and embargo calendar.
Ryan Park: marketing + partners — we should propose a timeline: 2 weeks for legal, 1 week for ops SKU mapping, 1 week for partner connector dev, then announcement window. total ~4 weeks. is that acceptable?
Sophie Patel: confirm legal will need: (a) redistribution addendum draft, (b) reseller/si clause, (c) export control paragraph, (d) attribution text. I'll start (a)+(b).
Jamal Owens: ops: will prototype per-entitlement geoblock today. put the feature flag behind `qb-gate` and add telemetry.
Alex Cheng: product will draft SKU mapping matrix: `quantumbridge.qb-hosted`, `quantumbridge.qb-onprem`, `quantumbridge.qb-entitlement-hw` (connector). will include pricing tiers and quantization label.
Maria Gonzalez: action items: Sophie (legal) draft addendum by EOD Tue, Jamal (ops) PoC geoblock by Thu, Alex (product) SKU matrix by Fri, Ryan (partner-eng) coordinate SiNova on connector approach and co-marketing deck. I'll sync with QuantumBridge on embargo windows.
Sophie Patel: noted. will ping @LegalOps for precedence doc. :spiral_calendar_pad:
Ryan Park: looping in announce-bot to reserve a joint-announcement slot: /announce reserve quantumbridge-sinova 2024-10-15 09:00 PT
announce-bot: Reservation created — quantumbridge-sinova — 2024-10-15 09:00 PT — owner: Maria Gonzalez
Alex Cheng: one more technical constraint from infra: compiled artifacts must be signed with provider key and we need verification in our runtime to allow redistribution. can we add a minimal verification step?
Jamal Owens: yes — will add signature verification to the entitlement validation flow. put the spec in the PR: `entitlement/verif/signature-v1`
Maria Gonzalez: thanks team. QuantumBridge asked for a short status cadence — i'll report back Wed AM. if anyone hits blockers DM me. :thumbsup:
Sophie Patel: uploaded a first-pass addendum draft: https://files.internal/legal/drafts/qb_addendum_draft.md — comments welcome.
Ryan Park: will share the SiNova connector requirements doc by EOD.
Alex Cheng: created a tracking ticket: RDW-PRT-3891 (SKU mapping + telemetry).
Jamal Owens: PoC branch opened: git:github.com/redwood/entitlement/tree/qb-gate — testing now.
Maria Gonzalez: closing loop — next sync Wed 10am PT. thanks all. :rocket:
